description: We're a team of passionate engineering students excited to tackle NASA's Space Apps Challenge 2026! We love space tech, coding, and creative problem-solving, and we want to turn NASA's open data into something impactful. We're looking for teammates with skills in Python/data analysis, web or app development, UI/UX design, storytelling/presentation, or research. Beginners are welcome, since curiosity and teamwork matter most. Join us and let's build something out of this world!
